subject: Redwood pilot — discovery recap & next steps

Subject: Redwood pilot — discovery recap & next steps

Hi Olivia — great to connect today. Quick recap of what we covered and agreed next steps: 

• Goal: Proof-of-concept to validate low-latency personalized recommendations for your lending product (target: 50ms median inference for 128-token requests).
• Success metrics: latency, endpoint availability (99.9% SLO), and 10% improvement in relevancy (A/B test).
• Proposed scope for pilot: 2-week integration + 2-week evaluation window. Redwood provides a sandbox model endpoint, prefix caching, and support for tokenized data pipeline.

Action items we landed on:
1) I’ll send discovery notes and a lightweight SOW draft for legal/procurement to review (attached).
2) Neon to confirm list of 3 representative prompts & an anonymized sample dataset (you mentioned procurement may need an internal review).
3) Schedule a 30–45m technical walkthrough with your engineering team + our SE (Soojin) to validate integration points.

I attached: 20260610-discovery-notes.pdf and a SOW draft (20260610-sow-draft.docx). Proposed times for the technical walkthrough: Tue 6/16 10am ET or Wed 6/17 2pm ET — happy to adjust.

If procurement wants an explicit data handling note, we can pull a short KMS/HSM summary for them. 

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
